before: Record base revision, cutoff, batch mode, frontier roots and facets.
Resolve identities and local-language aliases; identify issuer versus instrument.
Declare document review slots and query list.
Choose company mode (25 investigations) or project mode (5 projects).
during: Enumerate all entries in relevant dated lists, with original entry text and locator.
Resolve each entry or leave a named unresolved frontier lead.
Record every search and source section reviewed, blocked or pending.
Admit only explicit primary or attributed claims.
Preserve term units, fiscal period, scope and own evidence date.
Search both parties and relationship renewals/terminations.
Stop deeper investigation at two additional company hops; queue the rest.
Keep project participants separate from evidenced bilateral contracts.
before_validation: Resolve source/claim/company references and duplicated issuers.
Use null for unknown dates, exposure and quantities.
Check original publication/availability versus effective date.
Ensure direction is explicitly evidenced and reviewed.
Reject product attribution inferred from catalogue plus supplier membership.
Keep conflicts and supersession references; do not overwrite record IDs.
Record exclusions, gaps and next frontier; report process coverage.
publication: Inspect diff, warnings and coverage; fix errors.
Publish only against the validated base revision.
Preserve old revision and research log.
